messages:
lee: Idea: expose a lightweight "priority" toggle on API keys (P0/P1/P2) that influences routing, quota guilt-tracking, and telemetry sampling. want to validate quick assumptions before a short RFC. main points: 1) P0 -> low-latency pools (prefer dedicated when available), P1 -> balanced, P2 -> cost-optimized variants (quantized/cheap hw). 2) sampling: keep full traces for P0, sampled metrics for P1, aggregate counters for P2. 3) UX: simple dropdown + org-level override + bulk change.

anya: solid. small nit: call buckets P0/P1/P2 (instead of high/normal/low) in infra code to avoid market-facing wording. also surface estimated latency and cost delta on key edit.

mike: routing behavior notes: precedence should be explicit_route_on_key > project_flag > priority_bucket. add spill rules: if target pool maxed for P0, either enqueue, spill to P1, or fail depending on key config. default to spill->P1 with a throttle. need fail-open vs fail-closed discussion.

sam: telemetry proposal: sample_ratios {"P0":"100% traces", "P1":"20% to 50% traces (adaptive)", "P2":"1% traces + 100% aggregated counters"}. ingestion: tag events with {priority_bucket, target_pool, route_reason}. add dashboard panels: latency_by_priority, token_cost_by_priority, error_rate_by_priority.

lee: good. also add quota visibility: per-project quota breakdown by priority. don't expose per-key to org-wide view by default (privacy/noise). add anomaly alarm: when any single key in P2 consumes >30% of project token quota in 10m window.

mike: billing angle: no immediate price change. treat as routing & observability opt. however show expected spend delta in UI. if customers want guaranteed P0 capacity, productize as a reservation addon.

anya: implementation checklist: 1) route table updates to reference priority labels, 2) console UI for toggle + cost projection, 3) tracing tag additions, 4) quota aggregation changes, 5) rollout feature flag behind org opt-in. owners?

sam: i'll add the trace tags and dashboard panels. will also wire adaptive sampling for P1.

mike: i'll implement routing precedence and spill logic. will add a config knob per-key for spill strategy.

lee: ops-bot: upload mock links please.

ops-bot: mockups: https://redwood-internal.mockups/priority-p0p1p2/v1 and routing flow diag: https://redwood-internal.mockups/priority-flow/diagA

lee: rollout plan: alpha internal -> beta with 3 customers -> monitor (24/7) -> default flip after 2 weeks if no regressions. metric gates: no >5% increase in p95 latency for P1 within orgs, token unit cost delta <15% for aggregated org traffic, and anomaly rate <0.5% increase.

anya: also add migration rule: when adding this feature, set existing keys to P1 by default and annotate audit log for changes. provide CLI bulk command for admins to reassign.

mike: agree. one more: add a telemetry tag when spill happens so we can compute spill_rate per org/key. helps product decide on upsell nudges.

sam: will add spill_rate dimension.

lee: thanks team. i'll draft the RFC and attach the mockups + proposed sampling numbers. sync next Thu 3pm to review owners and gate thresholds. :thumbsup:
